name: Stonewatch Keep
summary: Blackrock orcs now hold Stonewatch Keep in eastern Redridge Mountains and turn its walls against Lakeshire. The Kingdom of Stormwind built and manned the fortress before the invaders seized it as a base for their warlords.

sections.title: A Fallen Bastion
sections.body: Stonewatch Keep once guarded the eastern ridges and Lakeshire's settlers from hostile incursions. Then the renegade warlock Morganth joined forces with the Blackrock clan. His dark magic strengthened the orcs, who stormed the fortress and overcame its human defenders. After the victory, Morganth abandoned the clan to raise the nearby Tower of Ilgalar and subjugate local gnolls. The Blackrock orcs kept the keep as a staging ground for attacks on the valley.

sections.title: The Warlord's Seat
sections.body:
A strong Blackrock garrison holds Stonewatch Keep under the orc warlord Gath'Ilzogg and his lieutenant, Tharil'zun. From the ramparts, they direct raids across Redridge and take prisoners, among them Stormwind's Corporal Keeshan.

Stormwind's forces are spread thin, so the kingdom cannot send a full regiment to reclaim the fortress. Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris have hired mercenary champions to enter the stronghold and kill the Blackrock leaders before Lakeshire is overrun.

faq.q: Who owns Stonewatch Keep right now?
faq.answer: The Blackrock clan holds Stonewatch Keep under Warlord Gath'Ilzogg and his lieutenant, Tharil'zun. The Alliance once held the fortress to protect Lakeshire.

faq.q: How did the Blackrock orcs capture the keep?
faq.answer: Morganth, a renegade human warlock, allied with the Blackrock clan. His dark magic strengthened the orcs as they stormed Stonewatch Keep and overwhelmed its human defenders.

faq.q: Why doesn't the Stormwind Army retake Stonewatch Keep?
faq.answer: Troop shortages and internal politics have left Redridge largely neglected by Stormwind's army. Lakeshire's leaders must rely on independent adventurers to face the threat.

faq.q: What is Morganth's connection to this fortress?
faq.answer: Morganth helped the Blackrock clan capture Stonewatch Keep, then abandoned them after their victory. He went to the nearby Tower of Ilgalar, raised his lair there, and used ensorcelled Shadowhide gnolls to do his bidding.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Stonewatch Keep recalls Stormwind's strained borders. Clearing its ramparts will help protect Lakeshire's vulnerable townsfolk.
As a human, you can honor Stonewatch's fallen defenders by helping free the keep and avenge the soldiers and captives taken by the Blackrock clan.
